Game Overview

In Line of Battle, the core idea is straightforward: command your steel titan through relentless warfare in Line of Battle. Strategize under fire as you navigate a dynamic battlefield, facing diverse challenges like fog and night combat. Every decision is vital in this gripping test of grit and strategy that elevates tank warfare to thrilling new heights.
